verdict.rationale: Sandbox0's docs say a sandbox is an isolated cloud computer where an agent can "run code, install software, manage files". Commands can run through Cmd/REPL contexts or an interactive shell over standard SSH. Supporting features include Docker-in-sandbox and a writable RootFS that grows online and persists across checkpoints, so installed packages survive. Missing for 10: a concrete package-install walkthrough (e.g., apt/pip examples or limits on root/privileges), and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond first-party docs.
